title: NArFU schedule data model (shared by the Python / Go / Rust implementations)
description: One data model every implementation of the schedule program must emit and consume. JSON keys are fixed snake_case; the same --json output is produced by py/, go/ and rust/ for the same request (byte-identical, key order as in this file).

num.description: Pair number as printed by the timetable, e.g. "1".

time_start.description: Start of the pair, 24h HH:MM, e.g. "08:20".

time_end.description: End of the pair, 24h HH:MM, e.g. "09:55".

kind.description: Kind of work as on the site: Лекция / Практическое занятие / Лабораторная работа / ...

subject.description: Discipline name without the lecturer suffix.

teacher.description: Short form exactly as the timetable prints it, e.g. "Абрамова Л.В.". Empty when the site lists no lecturer.

teacher_full.description: Resolved full name from the official staff list (e.g. "Абрамова Любовь Валерьевна"), or null when --full-names is off, the resolution is ambiguous, or the name is unknown.

addr.description: Building street address after the auditorium, e.g. "наб. Северной Двины, д. 2".

lessons.description: Sorted by pair number. Empty when the day column exists but has no classes.

group.description: Human group name as passed via --group; empty string when only --oid was given.

oid.description: RUZ timetable oid actually used for the request.

week_start.description: Monday of the returned window (ISO). For a single-day request it is the Monday of that day's week.

days.description: Published day columns within the window, in chronological order; a present day with an empty lessons array means that day has no classes; an absent day means the site does not publish it.
